title: Scheduling
description: See who is booked, available, or away — by day or week.

notAllowed.title: Scheduling is not available
notAllowed.body: You do not have permission to view the resource schedule.

empty.title: No people on this schedule yet
empty.body: Add employees, then book time or mark time off. Assigned projects and scheduled service calls appear here automatically.

readOnlyHint: Shown from the service schedule. Change it on the service call.
cancelConfirmBody: The time slot will be freed. This does not change time entries or pay.
overlapWarning: This overlaps another booking. Confirm to keep both.
overCapacityHint: Planned hours are above the usual {hours} hours for this period.

fields.plannedHoursHint: Leave empty to use the time between start and end.

errors.bookingOverlap: This overlaps another booking. Confirm to keep both, or pick a different time.
errors.unavailableOverlap: This overlaps time off. Pick a different time, or change the time off first.
errors.cancelledLocked: A cancelled booking cannot be changed.
